collectionMethod: Reviewed official facts, original native media, and firsthand reports; regional exploration followed by root full-card review.

trip.title: 京都到東京：看畫面，選出兩人想做的事
trip.destination: 京都、宇治、富士山周邊與東京
trip.intro: 先看實際照片與冬季影片，再各自選有興趣或沒興趣；不用先知道自己喜歡哪一類。資訊裡保留人潮、候位、冷天、步行、預約及季節取捨。這是探索清單，不是要全部走完的行程。

excludeFromCards: 京都到東京搭新幹線的既定交通偏好
constraints.fujiApproach: Do not presuppose overnight versus day trip; collect visual interest first. Scenic stops require later transport and weather review.

plans.title: 南禪寺水路閣沿紅磚拱門慢走拍照
plans.description: 沿還在輸水的紅磚拱門走一小段，觀察磚紋和光影。熱門構圖可能有人等拍照；可以接受照片裡有遊客，不必一直等空景。

image.alt: 南禪寺水路閣的連續紅磚拱門與碎石地面
image.credit: 日本國家旅遊局JNTO（原頁未另外標示攝影者）

source.title: 日本國家旅遊局｜南禪寺

facts.duration: 規劃估計：45–75分鐘
facts.cost: 水路閣外部散步；付費庭園或登樓另計，以官方公告為準。
facts.mobility: 戶外步行，路面有碎石及高低差；本卡不包含登三門。
facts.seasonalNote: 照片呈現建築，不代表12月樹葉或天氣。冬季遊記為二月到訪，不能保證雪景。

english.title: Walk beside Nanzenji's red-brick aqueduct
english.description: Walk a short stretch beside the working aqueduct and notice its brickwork and light. Popular compositions may attract people waiting for photos; this suits accepting other visitors in the frame rather than waiting for an empty scene.
english.imageAlt: Nanzenji's repeated red-brick aqueduct arches and gravel ground
english.imageCredit: JNTO; photographer not separately identified on the source page
english.sourceTitle: JNTO | Nanzenji Temple

facts.duration: Planning estimate: 45–75 minutes
facts.cost: Exterior walk; paid gardens or climbing the gate cost extra. Confirm official charges.
facts.mobility: Outdoor walking with gravel and changes in level; climbing Sanmon is not included.
facts.seasonalNote: The photo shows the structure, not December foliage or weather. The winter travelogue concerns February and does not guarantee snow.

plans.title: 宇治中村藤吉吃竹筒抹茶聖代
plans.description: 從有家紋圖案的抹茶表面往下吃，嚐竹筒裡不同層次的甜點。這是冷甜點而非熱茶；本店不接受咖啡座位預約，候位可能比吃的時間長。

image.alt: 竹筒抹茶聖代表面有白色家紋圖案
image.credit: 中村藤吉本店官方照片（原頁未另標示攝影者）

source.title: 中村藤吉本店｜官方活動與產品資訊

facts.duration: 規劃估計：30–45分鐘，候位或往返交通另計
facts.cost: 依當日菜單及所選份量；2026年12月售價尚未確認。
facts.mobility: 室內坐席用餐；可能店外站立候位，座位條件向店家確認。
facts.seasonalNote: 照片拍攝日期未明；12月營業、供應與現場安排再確認，不保證照片裡品項或人數相同。

english.title: Eat a bamboo-cup matcha parfait in Uji
english.description: Work down through the patterned matcha top and layered sweets in a bamboo cup. This is a cold dessert rather than hot tea. The Uji cafe does not take seating reservations, and waiting may take longer than eating.
english.imageAlt: Bamboo-cup matcha parfait with a white crest pattern
english.imageCredit: 中村藤吉本店 official photograph (no separate photographer credited on the page)
english.sourceTitle: 中村藤吉本店 | official activity and product information

facts.duration: Planning estimate: 30–45 minutes, plus waiting or transport
facts.cost: Depends on the daily menu and portion selected; December 2026 prices are not confirmed.
facts.mobility: Seated indoor dining; queues may require standing outside. Confirm seating arrangements.
facts.seasonalNote: The capture date is unknown; reconfirm December service, availability and arrangements. Pictured items or visitor numbers are not guaranteed.

plans.title: 河口湖產屋崎白天沿湖看富士山
plans.description: 在產屋崎沿湖慢走，看山與湖水，留時間坐下或找喜歡的角度。照片是作者2025年12月28日到訪所拍；清楚雪冠是那天的條件，遇雲仍可能看不到山。

image.alt: 冬季河口湖產屋崎的湖水、遠山與雪冠富士山
image.credit: まつきよ写真｜2025年12月28日到訪遊記

source.title: 日本國家旅遊局｜河口湖

facts.duration: 規劃估計：45–90分鐘，往返湖區交通另計
facts.cost: 湖畔散步不以付費活動為主；巴士或計程車另計。
facts.mobility: 戶外沿湖步行，冷風與等巴士都需考量；視路況縮短散步。
facts.seasonalNote: 作者明示2025年12月28日到訪；不是2026年天候預測。湖邊冷風、結冰、雲量可能改變觀賞體驗。

english.title: Take a daytime lakeside walk at Kawaguchiko's Ubuyagasaki
english.description: Walk slowly along the shore at Ubuyagasaki, leaving time to sit or find an angle you enjoy. The photographer visited on December 28, 2025; the clear snow-capped view was that day’s condition, and clouds can hide Fuji.
english.imageAlt: Lake water, distant mountains and snow-capped Fuji from Ubuyagasaki in winter
english.imageCredit: まつきよ写真 / Matsukiyo photography blog, visit on December 28, 2025
english.sourceTitle: JNTO | Lake Kawaguchi

facts.duration: Planning estimate: 45–75 minutes; lake-area transfers extra
facts.cost: Public lakeshore walk; meals, shopping and other facilities extra.
facts.mobility: Outdoor walking; adapt to cold wind and icy surfaces.
facts.seasonalNote: Explicit visit date: December 28, 2025. This is not a forecast for 2026. Wind, ice and clouds may change the experience.

plans.title: 東京Kakimori選封面與紙張訂做一本筆記本
plans.description: 各自選喜歡的封面、內頁和扣件，讓店員裝訂成一本帶回家的筆記本。選材本身是體驗；不把它當成不用等候的快速購物。

image.alt: Kakimori多種圖案和材質的線圈筆記本封面
image.credit: Kakimori官方照片

source.title: Kakimori｜訂製筆記本與預約規則

facts.duration: 規劃估計：60–90分鐘，製作與取件時間另向店家確認
facts.cost: 依封面、內頁、配件及加購而異；以當日官方報價為準。
facts.mobility: 店內選材與試寫；週末預約制，年底平日也可能需預約。
facts.seasonalNote: 目前週一休店；12月預約名額、封面款式與當日取件能力需確認。照片款式不保證有貨。

english.title: Choose a cover and paper for a custom notebook at Kakimori
english.description: Each of you chooses a cover, paper and fastener, then staff bind a notebook to take home. Choosing materials is part of the experience, rather than assuming this is quick shopping without a wait.
english.imageAlt: Kakimori spiral notebooks with different cover patterns and materials
english.imageCredit: Kakimori official photograph
english.sourceTitle: Kakimori | Order-made notebooks and booking conditions

facts.duration: Planning estimate: 60–90 minutes; confirm production and collection time separately
facts.cost: Varies with cover, paper, components and extras; use the shop's current quote.
facts.mobility: Choose materials and test paper in-store. Weekend reservations are required; year-end weekdays may also require booking.
facts.seasonalNote: Currently closed Mondays. Confirm December slots, cover choices and same-day collection. Pictured designs may not be stocked.

plans.title: 祇園花見小路沿町家街道慢走
plans.description: 沿公開街道看木造町家和街景，接受這也是車輛與行人使用的街道。影片是2025年12月6日週末實景，能看到有人與車，不是空街廣告照。

video.credit: VIRTUAL KYOTO｜2025-12-06週末祇園步行原片

source.title: 京都市官方旅遊指南｜祇園、花見小路交通與人潮

facts.duration: 規劃估計：45–75分鐘
facts.cost: 公開街道散步；餐飲或購物另計。
facts.mobility: 戶外步行、過路口及避讓車輛；遵守現場私有道路與拍攝標示。
facts.seasonalNote: 影片拍於12月上旬，不代表12月中下旬楓葉或人流；不安排追拍藝舞妓或闖入私巷。

english.title: Walk the machiya streets around Gion's Hanamikoji
english.description: Look at wooden townhouses from public streets, accepting that vehicles and pedestrians also use them. The video shows an actual weekend visit on December 6, 2025, with people and traffic rather than an empty promotional street.
english.sourceTitle: Kyoto official tourism | Gion and Hanamikoji traffic and crowds

facts.duration: Planning estimate: 45–75 minutes
facts.cost: Public-street walk; food and purchases cost extra.
facts.mobility: Outdoor walking, crossings and yielding to vehicles; follow private-road and photography signs.
facts.seasonalNote: Early-December footage does not predict mid-to-late-December foliage or crowds. Chasing geiko or maiko and entering private lanes are not included.

plans.title: 宇治轉石臼磨抹茶再體驗茶道
plans.description: 用手轉石臼把茶葉磨成粉，再在本店茶室參與薄茶體驗。想自己動手、了解一碗茶如何完成，可以選這張；活動需預約，不是隨到隨做。

image.alt: 手正在轉動石臼研磨茶葉
image.credit: 中村藤吉本店官方照片（原頁未另標示攝影者）

source.title: Otonami｜中村藤吉石臼磨茶與茶道體驗（日本語方案）

facts.duration: 規劃估計：60分鐘，候位或往返交通另計
facts.cost: 6,380日圓起／人只適用日語Otonami方案；英文／其他語言走全球Wabunka，兩人總價依該方案報價。
facts.mobility: 需要用手操作與集中注意力；座位、語言及操作方式預約時確認。
facts.seasonalNote: 本卡指約60分鐘、1–4人方案，兩人可參加。日語Otonami目前日、水、木開辦；英文或其他語言的日期可能不同，須另查Wabunka日曆及語言安排。

english.title: Grind matcha with a stone mill and try tea ceremony in Uji
english.description: Turn a stone mill by hand to grind tea leaves, then join a thin-matcha tea experience in the shop’s tea room. Choose this for hands-on interest in how a bowl of tea is made. Advance booking is required.
english.imageAlt: Hands turning a stone mill to grind tea leaves
english.imageCredit: 中村藤吉本店 official photograph (no separate photographer credited on the page)
english.sourceTitle: Otonami | Nakamura Tokichi stone-milling and tea ceremony, Japanese-language plan

facts.duration: Planning estimate: 60 minutes, plus waiting or transport
facts.cost: ¥6,380 per person is the Japanese Otonami starting price only. English/other-language bookings use global Wabunka; obtain its quote for two.
facts.mobility: Requires hand work and concentration; confirm seating, language and the method when booking.
facts.seasonalNote: This is the approximately 60-minute program for 1–4 guests; two may participate. Japanese Otonami currently offers Sunday, Wednesday and Thursday sessions. English/other-language dates may differ; check Wabunka’s calendar and language arrangements separately.

plans.title: 河口湖從纜車車窗看湖面與城鎮
plans.description: 乘纜車上天上山，從車窗看湖面與城鎮，再從山上眺望風景。願意為視角花門票與候車時間；富士山能見度依天候，這張照片呈現的是湖景。

image.alt: 河口湖纜車車窗邊的纜索、下方湖面與城鎮
image.credit: 日本國家旅遊局JNTO（原頁未另外標示攝影者）

source.title: 日本國家旅遊局｜富士山全景纜車

facts.duration: 規劃估計：60–90分鐘，排隊另計
facts.cost: 依當期官方票價；未查得可確定為12月的現行價。
facts.mobility: 纜車候位與山頂戶外停留；不安排徒步登山，站區與展望處仍可能有階梯。
facts.seasonalNote: 強風、天候或維修可能停駛；2025年12月遊記就遇到維修停駛。照片為綠葉時期，不代表12月植被。

english.title: See Lake Kawaguchi and the town from the cable-car window
english.description: Ride up Tenjo Mountain, looking at the lake and town from the cabin, then enjoy the views above. Choose it if the elevated perspective is worth the ticket and queue. Fuji visibility depends on the weather; this photo shows the lake.
english.imageAlt: Cable lines beside a cabin window above Lake Kawaguchi and the town
english.imageCredit: JNTO; photographer not separately identified on the source page
english.sourceTitle: JNTO | Mount Fuji Panoramic Ropeway

facts.duration: Planning estimate: 60–90 minutes, excluding queues
facts.cost: Use the operator's current fare; a December fare has not been verified.
facts.mobility: Waiting for the cable car and standing outdoors at the top; hiking uphill is not included, but station and viewpoint steps may remain.
facts.seasonalNote: Wind, weather or maintenance can stop operation; a December 2025 travelogue encountered a maintenance closure. The photo shows a leafy season, not December vegetation.

plans.title: 合羽橋跟老師做天婦羅和生菜食品模型
plans.description: 把蠟做成看起來能吃的天婦羅與生菜，兩人各帶自己的作品回家。這是需預約的課程；目前日語授課，不能用日語溝通時官方要求通譯同行。

image.alt: 用蠟製作的天婦羅與層層生菜食品模型
image.credit: 元祖食品サンプル屋／IWASAKI官方照片

source.title: 元祖食品サンプル屋｜合羽橋常設課程與參加條件

facts.duration: 規劃估計：官方課程約40分鐘，需提早10分鐘報到
facts.cost: 查核時3,300日圓／人；通譯安排與費用另計，12月名額需確認。
facts.mobility: 室內手作，手需接觸溫水；一個時段上限6人，可能與其他人一起上課。
facts.seasonalNote: 確認12月實際場次及語言安排後才可排入；模型不能食用，作品未必和示範照相同。

english.title: Make wax tempura and lettuce food models in Kappabashi
english.description: Turn wax into realistic tempura and lettuce, taking home your own creations. This class requires reservations and currently uses Japanese; the official rules require an accompanying interpreter if you cannot communicate in Japanese.
english.imageAlt: Wax food models of tempura and layered lettuce
english.imageCredit: Ganso Shokuhin Sample-ya / IWASAKI official photograph
english.sourceTitle: Ganso Shokuhin Sample-ya | Kappabashi class and participation conditions

facts.duration: Planning estimate: Official class duration about 40 minutes; arrive 10 minutes early
facts.cost: JPY 3,300 per person at review, plus any interpreter arrangements. Confirm December availability.
facts.mobility: Indoor handwork involving warm water. Each slot is limited to six participants and may be shared with others.
facts.seasonalNote: Only schedule after confirming December sessions and language arrangements. The models are not edible, and results may differ from the demonstration photo.

plans.title: 京都錦市場看乾貨、漬物與京料理食材
plans.description: 看攤位裡的漬物、乾貨與現做食物，挑想買的幾樣。影片是2025年12月29日年末實景，能看出通道、店面和行人；那天的人流不能當成你們旅期的預測。

video.credit: VIRTUAL KYOTO｜2025-12-29年末錦市場步行原片

source.title: 京都市官方旅遊指南｜錦市場與用餐規則

facts.duration: 規劃估計：45–75分鐘
facts.cost: 散步與購物依所選商品；各店價格為準。
facts.mobility: 市場步行、站立與讓路；有頂棚不代表全程室內暖房。
facts.seasonalNote: 拍攝2025-12-29、發布2025-12-30；年末人流不等於12/17–23。依官方規則在店前食用，不邊走邊吃。

english.title: Browse dried foods, pickles and Kyoto ingredients at Nishiki Market
english.description: Browse stalls for pickles, dried goods and freshly made food, then choose a few things to buy. This is a December 29, 2025 year-end walk showing the aisle, stalls and pedestrians; its crowd level is not a forecast for your dates.
english.sourceTitle: Kyoto official tourism | Nishiki Market and eating rules

facts.duration: Planning estimate: 45–75 minutes; queues extra
facts.cost: Depends on purchases; confirm current stall menus.
facts.mobility: Walking and standing in a narrow covered market; avoid blocking shoppers.
facts.seasonalNote: Filmed December 29, 2025 and published December 30. Year-end crowds do not predict December 17–23. Eat in front of the store, not while walking.

plans.title: 宇治買一份深綠色抹茶海綿蛋糕
plans.description: 選一份切片後有細緻氣孔的抹茶蛋糕，帶回住處配茶吃。它是可帶走的烘焙甜點，和需要現場候位的聖代是不同選擇。

image.alt: 切開的深綠色抹茶海綿蛋糕
image.credit: 中村藤吉本店官方照片（原頁未另標示攝影者）

source.title: 中村藤吉本店｜官方活動與產品資訊

facts.duration: 規劃估計：15–30分鐘，候位或往返交通另計
facts.cost: 官網查核時うじていら標示1,900日圓；門市包裝、售價與庫存再確認。
facts.mobility: 店內站立、觀看與選購；拿取或試用商品依店員指引。
facts.seasonalNote: 照片拍攝日期未明；12月營業、供應與現場安排再確認，不保證照片裡品項或人數相同。

english.title: Buy deep-green matcha castella in Uji
english.description: Choose matcha sponge cake with a fine crumb to enjoy with tea back at your accommodation. This is a take-away baked sweet, a different choice from waiting for a cafe parfait.
english.imageAlt: Slices of deep-green matcha castella
english.imageCredit: 中村藤吉本店 official photograph (no separate photographer credited on the page)
english.sourceTitle: 中村藤吉本店 | official activity and product information

facts.duration: Planning estimate: 15–30 minutes, plus waiting or transport
facts.cost: The official site lists Ujiteira at ¥1,900 when checked; confirm shop packaging, price and stock.
facts.mobility: Standing, browsing and shopping indoors; follow staff guidance for handling or trying products.
facts.seasonalNote: The capture date is unknown; reconfirm December service, availability and arrangements. Pictured items or visitor numbers are not guaranteed.

plans.title: 忍野八海沿清澈泉水與溪流散步
plans.description: 看清澈水流、池底與村落景色，願意多搭一段車，換另一種富士山周邊風景。官方說是常有人潮的熱門地點；有12月旅客覺得團客與觀光店太多，未必適合想安靜散步的人。

video.credit: Unique Japan Travel／Mona｜富士山冬季一日遊原片

source.title: 日本國家旅遊局｜忍野八海與人潮

facts.duration: 規劃估計：45–75分鐘，湖區往返交通另計
facts.cost: 一般散步、付費設施及購物分開；以各處官方價格為準。
facts.mobility: 戶外步行，臨水路段較窄；冬季依結冰與路況調整。
facts.seasonalNote: 影片2025年2月8日發布，作者稱冬季但未明示拍攝日；僅供看體驗，不代表12月積雪、人流或能見度。

english.title: Walk beside clear spring water and streams at Oshino Hakkai
english.description: Look at clear water, stream beds and village scenery, accepting an extra journey for a different Fuji-area experience. The official guide describes a popular, often-busy destination; a December traveler disliked the tour groups and commercial atmosphere, which may matter if quiet is your priority.
english.sourceTitle: JNTO | Oshino Hakkai and visitor crowds

facts.duration: Planning estimate: 45–75 minutes, excluding travel from the lake area
facts.cost: Ordinary walking, paid facilities and shopping are separate; use each operator's current prices.
facts.mobility: Outdoor walking with narrow waterside sections; adjust for ice and path conditions.
facts.seasonalNote: Published February 8, 2025, the video is described as winter footage without an exact filming date. It does not predict December snow, crowds or visibility.

plans.title: 六本木欅坂散步看藍白燈串與東京鐵塔
plans.description: 沿藍白燈串散步，找能把東京鐵塔一起看進去的角度。影片裡的十二月旅客拍到不少人聚在路口，作者也覺得擁擠；願意接受熱鬧，才把它當兩人的冬夜活動。

video.credit: 찬란한비｜十二月東京與六本木燈飾vlog

source.title: 森大廈｜六本木聖誕2026官方公告（2026-09-30）

facts.duration: 規劃估計：30–60分鐘
facts.cost: 戶外燈飾觀賞；餐飲、購物及其他活動另計。
facts.mobility: 坡道、人行道、過街與冷天站立；遵守引導，不停在車道拍照。
facts.seasonalNote: 主辦方已公告2026/11/5–12/25，涵蓋旅期。照片與vlog是往年實景，非今年完成畫面；點燈時間與當日引導再確認。

english.title: Walk Keyakizaka's blue-white lights with Tokyo Tower in view
english.description: Walk under the lights and find a view including Tokyo Tower. A December vlogger filmed many people gathering at crossings and found it crowded. Choose this as a winter evening together only if that bustle is acceptable.
english.sourceTitle: Mori Building | Roppongi Hills Christmas 2026 announcement, September 30, 2026

facts.duration: Planning estimate: 30–60 minutes
facts.cost: Outdoor illumination viewing; food, shopping and other activities cost extra.
facts.mobility: Slopes, sidewalks, crossings and standing in the cold; follow crowd guidance and stay out of traffic lanes for photos.
facts.seasonalNote: The organizer has announced November 5–December 25, 2026, covering the trip. The photo and vlog show earlier years, not this year's finished scene; recheck lighting times and on-site guidance.

plans.title: 伏見稻荷走一小段紅色鳥居通道
plans.description: 穿過連續紅色鳥居，看近距離的色彩與光線，走到覺得夠了就回頭。只選短段步行，不必登整座稻荷山；入口附近可能很擠，不以拍空景為前提。

image.alt: 伏見稻荷朱紅鳥居形成的狹長通道
image.credit: 日本國家旅遊局JNTO（原頁未另外標示攝影者）

source.title: 日本國家旅遊局｜伏見稻荷大社

facts.duration: 規劃估計：45–75分鐘
facts.cost: 境內短段散步；其他購物或餐飲另計。
facts.mobility: 戶外步行，路段有坡與階梯；依當天人潮決定折返位置。
facts.seasonalNote: 照片無人不代表旅期無人；避擠安排需看官方人潮資訊與當日情況，也要接受早起取捨。

english.title: Walk a short stretch of Fushimi Inari's red torii tunnel
english.description: Walk through repeated red gates to notice their color and light, turning back when satisfied. This is a short walk, not climbing all of Mount Inari. The entrance area can be crowded; an empty photo is not the premise.
english.imageAlt: A narrow passage formed by Fushimi Inari's vermilion torii gates
english.imageCredit: JNTO; photographer not separately identified on the source page
english.sourceTitle: JNTO | Fushimi Inari Taisha

facts.duration: Planning estimate: 45–75 minutes
facts.cost: Short shrine-ground walk; shopping and dining cost extra.
facts.mobility: Outdoor paths with slopes and steps; choose the turnaround point according to conditions.
facts.seasonalNote: An empty photograph does not mean an empty visit. Avoiding crowds requires current official information and accepting possible early-start tradeoffs.

plans.title: 宇治在木製組台上編自己的組紐
plans.description: 選線色，把八股線依順序交替移動，慢慢編成一條組紐，再選做吊飾或手環等小物。照片顯示真正的手編動作，兩人可以各選自己喜歡的配色。

image.alt: 雙手在方形木台上交叉藍色線，周圍垂著木製線軸
image.credit: 昇苑くみひも官方照片（原頁未另標示攝影者）

source.title: 昇苑くみひも｜官方活動與產品資訊

facts.duration: 規劃估計：60分鐘，候位或往返交通另計
facts.cost: 查核時3,850日圓／人，兩人7,700日圓；成品配件與旅期報價再確認。
facts.mobility: 需要用手操作與集中注意力；座位、語言及操作方式預約時確認。
facts.seasonalNote: 至少提前一週預約，目前受理兩個月內的日期；11:00或13:30，每次最多4人，年末年始及特別休業除外。

english.title: Braid your own cord on a wooden stand in Uji
english.description: Choose colors and move eight strands in sequence to braid a cord, then choose small finished items such as a strap or bracelet. The photo shows the actual hand-braiding action; each person can choose their own colors.
english.imageAlt: Hands crossing blue strands on a square wooden stand with hanging wooden bobbins
english.imageCredit: 昇苑くみひも official photograph (no separate photographer credited on the page)
english.sourceTitle: 昇苑くみひも | official activity and product information

facts.duration: Planning estimate: 60 minutes, plus waiting or transport
facts.cost: At checking, ¥3,850 per person, or ¥7,700 for two; confirm fittings and the trip-period quote.
facts.mobility: Requires hand work and concentration; confirm seating, language and the method when booking.
facts.seasonalNote: Reserve at least one week ahead; bookings currently open two months ahead. Starts at 11:00 or 13:30, with up to four people, excluding year-end and special closures.

plans.title: 三島Skywalk走400公尺吊橋看開闊風景
plans.description: 走過長吊橋，看山谷與駿河灣方向，天氣清楚時也能望富士山。可以當京都往東京途中另研究的短停，但要多一段車程；不把它和河口湖全部硬塞在同一天。

image.alt: 三島Skywalk吊橋中央步道、兩側欄杆與高聳吊索
image.credit: 三島Skywalk官方照片

source.title: 三島Skywalk｜票價、營業與設施

facts.duration: 規劃估計：60–90分鐘，三島車站往返另計
facts.cost: 查核時成人1,100日圓起，採變動價格；12月票價與交通另確認。
facts.mobility: 戶外吊橋可能感到晃動、風吹與高度；怕高者可直接不選。
facts.seasonalNote: 富士山可見度與通行依天候及官方公告；照片為綠葉時期。三島與河口湖是不同觀景側，交通需另查。

english.title: Walk Mishima Skywalk's 400-meter suspension bridge
english.description: Cross the long bridge for valley and Suruga Bay views, with Fuji possible in clear weather. It can be researched as an extra stop between Kyoto and Tokyo, but requires another journey; do not automatically combine it with all of Kawaguchiko in one day.
english.imageAlt: The central Mishima Skywalk deck, railings and tall suspension cables
english.imageCredit: Mishima Skywalk official photograph
english.sourceTitle: Mishima Skywalk | Tickets, opening and facilities

facts.duration: Planning estimate: 60–90 minutes, excluding travel from Mishima Station
facts.cost: Adult admission starts at JPY 1,100 at review with variable pricing; confirm December tickets and transport.
facts.mobility: Outdoor suspension bridge with possible movement, wind and a sense of height; decline if heights are uncomfortable.
facts.seasonalNote: Fuji visibility and bridge access depend on weather and official notices. The photo shows a leafy season. Mishima and Kawaguchiko view different sides of Fuji and need separate transport checks.

plans.title: 東京Kakimori試寫不同筆記本內頁紙張
plans.description: 在店內用筆試寫，感受不同紙張的滑順、線條與墨水表現。只想逛文具、試手感，不一定要訂做整本筆記本，可以單獨選這張。

image.alt: 在Kakimori紙張試寫區拿筆試寫的手與樣品架
image.credit: Kakimori官方照片

source.title: Kakimori｜訂製筆記本與預約規則

facts.cost: 是否購買依所選商品；試寫安排與可用範圍向店員確認。
facts.mobility: 店內站立與短時間試寫；需讓其他客人也能使用樣品。
facts.seasonalNote: 官方允許試寫紙張；12月營業、樣品與店內安排可能不同，目前週一休店。

english.title: Test different notebook papers at Kakimori
english.description: Write on sample paper to feel its smoothness and see how lines and ink behave. Choose this independently if stationery and materials appeal without necessarily ordering a whole notebook.
english.imageAlt: A hand testing paper beside Kakimori's writing samples
english.imageCredit: Kakimori official photograph

facts.cost: Purchases depend on chosen products; confirm the testing arrangements with staff.
facts.mobility: Standing and brief writing in-store; leave sample access for other customers.
facts.seasonalNote: The official description permits testing papers. December opening, samples and shop arrangements may differ; currently closed Mondays.

plans.title: 祇園Gion Duck Noodles吃鴨肉湯拉麵
plans.description: 細麵配鴨肉切片和鴨湯，先吃原味，再加入山椒改變香氣。比豚骨拉麵多一種鴨肉與柑橘辛香的選擇，熱門時段可能候位。

image.alt: 白盤裡的細麵、鴨肉切片與湯汁

english.title: Eat duck-broth ramen at Gion Duck Noodles
english.description: Try fine noodles with sliced duck and duck broth, then add sansho pepper for a citrusy aroma. This offers a different taste from pork-bone ramen; busy periods may involve a wait.

plans.title: 宇治昇苑挑一個彩色組紐小吊飾
plans.description: 比較線色、圓結與小吊環，挑一個能掛在常用物品上的成品。這是逛店購買，不必預約手編課；照片為品牌款式示例，庫存到店確認。

english.title: Choose a colorful braided-cord accessory at Showen

plans.title: 箱根彫刻之森在山間戶外看大型雕塑
plans.description: 沿美術館園路看大型雕塑，把山景和藝術放在同一段散步。可作為不泡湯的箱根候選；它是額外山區交通，不代表去河口湖順路，也不保證能看富士山。

image.alt: 箱根彫刻之森室外園路旁一列彩色大型幾何雕塑

facts.cost: 查核時成人現場2,000日圓、網購1,800日圓／人；12月以館方為準。

english.title: Walk among large outdoor sculptures in Hakone's mountains
english.description: Follow museum paths among sculptures, combining mountain surroundings with art. This is a Hakone option without bathing, but requires extra mountain travel; it is not automatically on the way to Kawaguchiko and does not guarantee a Fuji view.
english.imageAlt: Large colorful geometric sculptures beside an outdoor path at the Hakone Open-Air Museum
english.imageCredit: Hakone Open-Air Museum official photograph; artwork credits follow the museum
english.sourceTitle: Hakone Open-Air Museum | Outdoor sculpture and permanent facilities

facts.duration: Planning estimate: 90–150 minutes, excluding travel to Hakone
facts.cost: At review, adult tickets are JPY 2,000 on site or JPY 1,800 online; confirm December charges.
facts.mobility: Mainly outdoor paths, with mountain wind and ground conditions to consider; footbaths are not included.
facts.seasonalNote: The photo shows a leafy season; vegetation and artwork access may differ in December. Do not automatically fit both Hakone and Kawaguchiko into one day.

plans.title: 人形町今半慢慢吃牛肉壽喜燒
plans.description: 薄片牛肉、豆腐與蔬菜在甜鹹醬汁中煮熟，留一餐坐下慢慢吃。比一碗麵花更多時間與預算；選餐與預約需先確認。

image.alt: 鐵鍋裡的牛肉片、豆腐、蔬菜與甜鹹湯汁，筷子正在夾起牛肉

plans.title: 宇治朝日燒在素燒茶杯畫自己的圖案

facts.mobility: Garden paths; walk around stones, roots and small slopes as needed.
